notes.title: Game release and updated demo
notes.notes:
We heard your requests and applied them. The game now has an undo functionality. We spent the last weeks fixing the last bugs, playtesting and adjusting all 40 levels of the game.

It's been an incredible journey and we hope you will like the final result.

In the meantime you can try out our updated demo!

See you monday :)

notes.title: RYBot Demo and release news
notes.notes:
We'll be releasing a demo this next Monday, it will feature 6 levels, 4 that teaches and reinforces game mechanics, and 2 that will give you a bit of a challenge. 

We're well on our way to release the full game on time for the 26th of February. We are going to host a small playtest session between the demo and the release, get in on our discord server if you're interested :) https://discord.gg/HBP7kv5f3M

Stay tuned!
